title: A small introduction goes a long way
summary: A sample language note on saying hello and introducing yourself.

content.text: Example lesson: “Hallo, ich heiße Kian.” means “Hello, my name is Kian.” “Wie heißt du?” asks “What is your name?” in an informal conversation.
In a simple statement, the conjugated verb comes in the second position: ich heiße. In the question Wie heißt du?, the question word comes first and the verb follows.

items: Ich heiße Kian. — My name is Kian.
Freut mich! — Nice to meet you!

content.text: Try it: say a greeting, introduce yourself, then ask the other person their name. This is an example practice prompt, not a record of completed practice.

source.label: Demonstration lesson · not a personal learning record
